newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty closes flat vs basket, one-day depos slide.
newsitem.headline: Zloty closes flat vs basket, one-day depos slide.

text.p: 1320 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at 2.96/2.93 pct from the trading band centre, unchanged from Friday's close at 2.98/2.90 pct after intraday swings caused by client currency buying orders and speculation, dealers said.
* It closed at 3.0390/00 to the dollar, up from 3.0460/90 on Friday and at 1.8137/42 to the mark, down from 1.8090/00.
* O/N at 21.40/21.60 pct vs opening's 22.40/22.59 pct.
* T/N at 21.43/21.63 pct vs opening's 22.45/22.61 pct.
* Investors bid for 362 million zlotys of Polish T-bills at the treasury's one billion zloty primary auction.
